description: This file defines a class 'DoubleBarLayout' that implements a pagination layout interface. It generates HTML pagination links for navigating through pages, including first, previous, next, last, and numbered page links, with ellipsis for skipped pages.

classes.name: DoubleBarLayout
classes.description: Implements page layout with double bar pagination controls, generating HTML links for page navigation.

methods.name: fetchPagedLinks
methods.description: Generates HTML pagination links for navigating between pages, including handling ellipses and first/last page links.
